items.summary: I always have to remind myself that in #godotengine, _physics_process() happens BEFORE _process(). Which makes sense, if you think about it. But that also means if you have something (a variable for example) that needs to be up to date in both functions, just updating it in _process() is causing the result to be one frame late in _physics_process().
